subject: objections to truecap, handled
preheader: i hear the same three things. here are honest answers.
headline: Three honest pushbacks on TrueCap, and what I'd say back.
body: "I already have a spreadsheet." A good spreadsheet is genuinely powerful. TrueCap is useful as a faster first pass with labeled assumptions; keep using your detailed model for the properties that survive the screen and reconcile any differences.

"I trust my gut." Experience matters for questions a model cannot answer, such as condition and local operations. Standardized cash-flow and DSCR calculations add a second check, but they are only as reliable as the inputs and lender-specific definitions you verify.

"Pro costs too much for my workflow." That may be true. Use Free if a first-pass screen is enough. Investor Pro is intended for people who repeatedly need reusable target profiles, an interactive Offer Ceiling, saved opportunities, comparisons, projections, and reports; compare the current price and offered cadence with your own usage before upgrading.

Free requires no card. Eligible new accounts can use a separate 21-day, no-card free trial for up to three new evaluation deals and one comparison; it does not charge or renew. Paid Investor Pro is offered monthly or annually when the matching catalog-verified Stripe Price is configured, renews until canceled, and requires a card at checkout. Review the pricing and terms shown before purchase.
